manifest.author: Cobblr community
manifest.readme_md:
# Lego Collector

Adds the custom fields a Lego user actually wants on `inventory:part`, plus a label wire formatted for a Lego shelf.

## Recommended companion bundle

Install **Rebrickable catalogs** (`cobblr.community.rebrickable-catalogs`) before using this. With both bundles + the seeder run, the inventory quick-add typeahead searches every Rebrickable catalog at once, pre-fills name + image + year on pick, and writes a `matches → core-catalogs:entry` pairing automatically. Empty Lego fields fall back to the matched catalog entry's payload at render time.

## What it adds

- **set_id** — Rebrickable set number (e.g. `75192-1`). Rendered as code.
- **year** — Release year. Renders as a year.
- **theme** — Star Wars / City / Bionicle / etc.
- **color** — Primary color. (For loose parts.)
- **condition** — sealed / built / used / damaged / loose. Choice list.
- **state** — sealed / built / parted-out / partial. Set lifecycle.
- **minifig_count** — How many minifigs in the set.

## Label wire

On any `inventory:part` row, the EntityActionsBar surfaces a **Print label** action. Template:

`LEGO {{theme}} #{{set_id}} • {{name}} ({{year}})`

Fields with no local value fall back to the matched Rebrickable entry — so `theme` and `year` print correctly even if you didn't fill them in.
